purpose: Second NUTS configuration for Example 2, Setting 1: dense NUTS at target acceptance 0.99, otherwise identical to the ex2_nuts stage of production_v2 (target 0.95). Divergence follow-up of that run (user decision, 28 Oct 2026): it triggered the follow-up rule (12 divergences, 9 in one chain, 7 of them in draws 1261-1281 in the upper tail of the depth posterior), and its upper depth tail is lighter than that of pCN (production_v2_pcn2m): 95 % and 99 % quantiles of d 0.7827 and 0.7933 against 0.7845 and 0.7983, i.e. -2.4 and -2.8 combined MCSE. Declared and frozen before the run; production_v2 and production_v2_pcn2m are kept unchanged and reported alongside. A change of any setting requires a new manifest id and output tag.

model.plateau_bounds_note: joint-setting bounds of config.py, checked by the driver but not used by the v1 stages

data.note: existing observation files; their bytes are tracked in git and must not be regenerated

nuts.target_rationale: sensitivity run for the divergence follow-up of the Example 2 run at target 0.95 (production_v2); smaller steps may reach the region of the upper depth tail where that run diverged. In Example 1, target 0.99 did not reduce the number of divergences (21 against 26)

pcn.tuning: none during the production run (fixed beta)
pcn.beta_rule: 8 x the mean tuned beta (0.02896267488461425) of 4 chains tuned to acceptance 0.234 (pilot_ex2.sh), selected from the Example 2 sweep f = 6, 8, 12 by the largest smallest bulk-or-tail ESS over all monitored quantities per PDE solve of the retained draws (rule declared before the sweep, same lengths as the Example 1 sweep); the best f was interior, so the sweep was not extended
pcn.sweep_result: bottleneck ESS per 1000 PDE solves (4 x 100 000 draws): 6x 0.035, 8x 0.061, 12x 0.039; max R-hat 1.12-1.22, so these are budget-limited estimates; at this rate the cap of 500 000 draws per chain is expected to give a bottleneck ESS of about 120, i.e. 'not reached within the cap' is the likely outcome
pcn.cap_decision: same caps as Example 1 (user decision, 27 Oct 2026, from the revised manuscript text)
pcn.note: not run under this manifest; the Example 2 pCN run is production_v2_pcn2m

diagnostics.monitored: all KL coefficients and the junction depth at x = 0.5; c_p and c_n in the joint setting
diagnostics.undefined: an undefined R-hat or ESS of any monitored quantity means not passed
diagnostics.checkpoints: retrospective, on prefixes of the capped runs; costs from per-draw records; first pass reported with persistence, or 'not reached within the cap'

divergences.follow_up_rule: more than 0.5 % of the retained draws, or at least 3 divergences with 75 % or more in one chain
divergences.handling: report count, chain and location; keep the output; investigate the states; never change settings silently

timing.batches: one four-chain sampler batch at a time, no other heavy jobs on the machine
reported: aggregate worker time (sum over chains), sampling only and including warm-up
actual batch elapsed time from launch to the last chain end (epoch timestamps)
timing.excluded_from_sampler_timers: model construction and KL set-up (included in the batch elapsed time)

failure_handling: outputs are validated with check_run.py --production; an invalid output stops the driver and is kept for inspection; a valid run that fails the diagnostics or needs divergence follow-up is kept and flagged, never silently rerun with other settings
scope: Example 2, known plateaus (Setting 1): stage ex2_nuts only, NUTS at target acceptance 0.99.

predeclared.reporting: Table 2 and the appendix report three Example 2 rows: pCN (production_v2_pcn2m), NUTS at target 0.95 (production_v2) and NUTS at target 0.99 (this manifest)
predeclared.rules: the convergence thresholds and the divergence follow-up rule of production_v2 apply unchanged
predeclared.primary_nuts_configuration: target 0.95 (production_v2) remains the primary Example 2 configuration, whatever the outcome of this run
predeclared.upper_tail_check: compare_samplers.py with the pCN run of production_v2_pcn2m as reference: this run agrees with pCN in the upper depth tail if |z| <= 2 at both the 95 % and the 99 % quantile of d (z = difference / combined MCSE); the outcome is reported either way, together with the same check of the target-0.95 run (z = -2.4 and -2.8)
predeclared.not_decided_here: the NUTS settings of the joint reconstruction are fixed in its own manifest before its run
